description: This tool is for analyzing Stripe Sigma and Metrics data (e.g. about revenue, charges, products, invoices, subscriptions, disputes, transactions, tax tables, payments etc) and run…

intent.description: The intent of the tool call.

params.description: The parameters for the tool call. Required parameters depend on the intent.

dimensions.description: Used with execute_query_template. Dimensions to group by: 'product', 'price'.

grains.description: Used with execute_query_template. Time grain: 'day', 'week', or 'month'. Default is 'month'.

metric.description: Used with execute_query_template. The canonical metric name.

metric_filters.description: Used with execute_query_template. Filters to apply: 'top5' or 'all'. Default is 'all'.

query_run_id.description: Used with retrieve_query_run or retrieve_query_template. The QueryRun ID to retrieve.

result_options.description: Used with execute_query_run. Optional settings for the QueryRun results.

compress_file.description: Whether to compress the generated results file.

search_string.description: Used with search_query_tables. Keyword to search table names and descriptions.

sql.description: Used with execute_query_run. The SQL query to execute (Trino 414).

table_name.description: Used with retrieve_query_table. The table name.

name: stripe.stripe_analytics
